$comment: Generic Music Video Generation Project Template. Edit this file or create a new one using 'render_video.bat --new <your_song>.json'.

video_shared_settings.negative_prompt: split-screen, split frame, vertical divider, dividing line, vertical seam, border, two panels, split image

resolution_options_quick_reference.1: 832x480   - 480p Fast Preview (~1 min/s video, lowest VRAM, best for quick motion tests)
resolution_options_quick_reference.2: 960x544   - 540p qHD Balanced (~1.5 min/s video, good balance for full-song drafts)
resolution_options_quick_reference.3: 1280x720  - 720p HD Standard  (~2.5 min/s video, crisp standard 16:9 widescreen)
resolution_options_quick_reference.4: 1344x768  - 768p WXGA High-Res (DEFAULT) (~3.2 min/s video, recommended native DiT detail)
resolution_options_quick_reference.5: 1536x864  - 864p Near-1080p   (~4.5 min/s video, high fidelity for hero scenes)
resolution_options_quick_reference.6: 1920x1088 - 1080p Full HD     (~6-7 min/s video, cinema-grade DiT multiple-of-16 preset)

variables.LEAD_SINGER: a charismatic performer in modern stage attire with expressive eyes and natural movement
variables.STAGE_SETTING: a dark cinematic soundstage with warm amber spotlights, subtle atmospheric haze, and soft bokeh in the background

anchors.prompt: Cinematic 16:9 medium close-up of {LEAD_SINGER} standing at a vintage brass microphone inside {STAGE_SETTING}. Natural posture, eyes open and emotive, warm directional lighting.

Cinematic 16:9 wide establishing shot inside {STAGE_SETTING}. In the distance, {LEAD_SINGER} stands in a circular pool of spotlight on the polished wooden floor. Atmospheric haze and deep cinematic contrast.

scenes.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Continue directly from <Picture 1>. Inside {STAGE_SETTING}, {LEAD_SINGER} begins singing with natural head sway and expressive lip movements matching the audio. Slow cinematic push-in.
overall_soundscape: Studio room tone under vocal performance.
